rules._comment: ADD PHASE baseline (all roles, while Stalagg is alive; detect:nearest is threat-independent so it drives the approach/split from range). Attack the nearest add. sticky:false so a tank yanked to the other add by Magnetic Pull swaps to the now-nearest add instead of running back to its original target.
ADD PHASE baseline, while Feugen is alive (covers the window where Stalagg died first).

ADD PHASE positioning -- TANK on the Stalagg platform. adds_near (proximity, range 55 < half the ~120y platform gap) means this fires only for the tank actually next to Stalagg, and it FOLLOWS a Magnetic Pull (after the pull the tank is next to the other add, so the other platform's rule takes over). stack_point with z=312.61 forces the climb ONTO the platform (3D move) so the tank holds the add up there -- if the add comes off its platform the raid gets nuked. taunt re-grabs aggro after the pull.
ADD PHASE positioning -- TANK on the Feugen platform.

ADD PHASE positioning -- NON-TANKS on the Stalagg platform climb up to the ranged anchor (z=312.61) so melee can reach the add and ranged stay inside the Tesla Coil leash. They commit to their side (no pull), then DPS via the baseline rule once parked.
ADD PHASE positioning -- NON-TANKS on the Feugen platform.

THADDIUS PHASE -- polarity grouping. Negative charge -> LEFT spots, Positive -> RIGHT, melee vs ranged offset. 1:1 port of ThaddiusMovePolarityAction's 6 fixed anchors. detect:nearest so a freshly-descended bot positions before it builds threat. stack_point yields once parked, so the boss-DPS rule below fires while clustered.
THADDIUS PHASE -- DPS the boss whenever not repositioning for polarity. Default threat detection, so this never fires on the non-attackable Thaddius during the add phase.

suppress._comment: No formation-follow / master-follow during the fight: the stock movers re-pull bots toward the master every tick and fight the Level-2 positioning (the platform climb and the polarity stack). One entry per phase actor so it covers the add phase (Feugen/Stalagg) and the Thaddius phase. Mirrors Grobbulus/Gluth. NOTE: 'reach melee' is intentionally NOT suppressed (melee need it to close on the add/boss once on the platform); add it to the Thaddius-phase entry if melee dance off the polarity anchor in testing.

DEATH-SYNC throttle: zero a bot's non-healing damage casts while its current add is <=40% HP and the other add is >=3% higher, so the two adds finish within the ~5s revive window. Self-deactivates in the Thaddius phase (adds dead -> current target is Thaddius -> trigger false). Data form of ThaddiusGenericMultiplier's <=40%/>=3% DPS clamp.
